title: Photo Analysis Profile
description: Structured analysis of a real photograph, used as the basis for downstream style scoring and technique matching.

color.description: Color analysis: warmth, saturation, dominant colors, skin tone, and color cast.

color_cast.description: White balance color cast, as a short description; use "neutral" when no cast is present.

dominant_colors.description: Dominant colors or color environments, for example "green dominant environment".

items.description: A single dominant color or color environment.

saturation.description: Overall color saturation, from desaturated (0) to highly saturated (1).

skin_tone.description: Skin tone rendering, as a short description such as "warm"; use "not_applicable" when no skin is present.

warmth.description: Overall color temperature, from cool (0) to warm (1).

composition.description: Composition analysis: frame orientation, aspect ratio, shot scale, subject position, perspective, and horizon.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio, for example "3:2" or "16:9".

horizon.description: Horizon placement and levelness, for example "upper third, level".

orientation.description: Frame orientation; one of vertical, horizontal, or square.

perspective.description: Perspective character of the shot, for example "wide-angle" or "telephoto compression".

shot_scale.description: Shot scale of the main subject, for example "medium close-up".

subject_position.description: Position of the main subject within the frame, for example "center-left".

depth.description: Depth analysis: original depth of field as captured, and the relative weight of the foreground, midground, and background layers.

background.description: Relative visual weight and separation of the background layer, from minimal (0) to dominant (1).

dof.description: Depth of field (dof), from very shallow (0) to deep (1).

foreground.description: Relative visual weight and separation of the foreground layer, from minimal (0) to dominant (1).

midground.description: Relative visual weight and separation of the midground layer, from minimal (0) to dominant (1).

image_condition.description: Technical image condition: exposure, dynamic range, noise, detail, local contrast, and white balance confidence. White balance/color cast and saturation are recorded in color; original depth of field is recorded in depth.

detail.description: Fine detail and sharpness, from soft or lacking detail (0) to highly detailed (1).

dynamic_range.description: Usable tonal dynamic range retained in the image, from very limited (0) to wide (1).

exposure.description: Exposure assessment, for example "underexposed", "slightly underexposed", "correct", "slightly overexposed", or "overexposed".

local_contrast.description: Local (micro) contrast, from flat (0) to strong (1).

noise.description: Noise level, from clean (0) to heavily noisy (1).

white_balance_confidence.description: Confidence that the white balance/color cast assessment recorded in color.color_cast is correct, from no confidence (0) to full confidence (1).

light.description: Lighting analysis: direction, type, quality, contrast, character, shadows, ambient level, backlight and side light flags, analysis confidence, and whether light sculpting is permitted.

ambient_level.description: Overall ambient brightness of the environment, from dark (0) to bright (1).

backlight.description: Whether the key light is predominantly behind the subject (backlight present).

character.description: Qualitative character of the light, for example "warm natural daylight".

confidence.description: Confidence in the lighting analysis, from no confidence (0) to full confidence (1).

contrast.description: Lighting contrast between highlights and shadows, from low (0) to high (1).

direction.description: Direction of the key light relative to the subject; one of left_side, right_side, front, back, top, mixed, or unknown.

hardness.description: Light quality, from soft (0) to hard (1).

light_sculpting_allowed.description: Whether light-sculpting (relighting) techniques may be applied to this image.

shadow_direction.description: Direction in which shadows fall in the frame, as a short description.

side_light.description: Whether the key light is predominantly side light.

type.description: Lighting type; one of side, side_back, back, front, top, flat, or mixed.

mood.description: Mood descriptors of the image, for example "quiet", "documentary", or "humanistic"; at least one, without duplicates.

post_processing_potential.description: Estimated potential for improvement through post-processing, from none (0) to high (1).

quality.description: Overall photographic quality, from poor (0) to excellent (1).

risks.description: Regions or facts most at risk of being altered incorrectly in post-processing, for example faces, architecture, terrain, sky, reflections, or animal forms.

items.description: A single at-risk region or fact.

subject.description: Subject analysis: main subject class and tags, classification confidence, subject weight versus environment weight, and their narrative relationship.

class.description: Primary subject class used by the decision engine; one of the listed values, written exactly as given.

confidence.description: Confidence in the subject classification, from no confidence (0) to full confidence (1).

environment_weight.description: Visual and narrative weight of the surrounding environment in the frame, from negligible (0) to dominant (1).

narrative.description: Short description of the narrative relationship between the main subject and the environment.

subject_weight.description: Visual and narrative weight of the main subject in the frame, from negligible (0) to dominant (1).

tags.description: Fine-grained subject labels, for example "portrait", "human", or "elderly"; without duplicates.

uncertainties.description: Judgments that could not be confirmed from the image and must not be guessed.
